architectureDecisions: D1 — BB-081 is acceptance/attribution/publication only; it cannot mutate delivered dependencies or benchmark/effect/product authority.
D2 — Profiles: A=CORE_SYNC; B=A+BB-078; C=B+BB-079; D=C+BB-080. B/C are diagnostic; D is the sole promotion candidate. Exact DONE exports must compose independently or fail PLAN_INPUT_CONTRADICTION.

D3 — Real treatment activation: all arms expose the same BB-077 capability name/input contract through one identical deterministic effect binder and terminal-or-operation response union; A invokes synchronously, B/C/D wrap the same capability through BB-078. All-eight-D zero detachable calls => INCONCLUSIVE.

D4 — Held-out cohort is the four BB-077 Terminal-Bench digests, two repeats each, 32 arm units. Use the frozen balanced order schedule and fresh Harbor/runtime/provider-session state per unit; all retries stay append-only.
D5 — Reuse HARNESS_RUN_RECORD_V1 and BB-077 measurement/failure semantics. Primary comparison is D/A; report A→B, B→C, C→D marginal vectors separately with no aggregate winner score.

D6 — Deterministic fault fixtures cover provider timeout/429/ambiguous completion/tool failure (A-D), kill/cancel/non-reconcilable ambiguity (B-D), duplicate transition (C-D), duplicate wake and stale-model-after-steer (D). N/A is not pass.
D7 — D safety is absolute: duplicate external effects=0; no lost terminal result; unsafe cancellation, stale-model dispatch, turn storm or unresolved NON_RECONCILABLE ambiguity blocks promotion.
D8 — Primary gate over eight matched D/A task-repeat units: accepted-task rate D>=A; median normalized cost<=0.85; prompt-input tokens<=0.90; model turns<=1.00; elapsed<=1.10; plus D safety gate.
D9 — Reducer outcomes are PROMOTE_ASYNC, KEEP_SYNC_BASELINE or INCONCLUSIVE. Complete known evidence + any primary failure => KEEP; missing/unknown/budget/binding/fault evidence => INCONCLUSIVE.

D10 — Publish CORE_ASYNC_FIRST_V1 only after PROMOTE_ASYNC. CORE_SYNC remains supported; createAgentRuntime defaults stay unchanged; evidence binds protocol/dependency/provider/source/decision hashes and rollback is new/quiescent-session only.
D11 — BB-074 is downstream and cannot tune this gate. Repeated rollout evidence is reported as variance/consistency, never best-of-k or a significance claim.
D12 — Jev validates exact evidence claims but cannot override the deterministic reducer or become profile-selection authority.

S2 — Materialize A/B/C/D, held-out digests, two-repeat balanced schedule, fixed BB-077 profile/budget and fresh-unit reset contract.

S7 — Publish execution-profile contract and Core Living Docs only from the verified decision; preserve CORE_SYNC and quiescent rollback.

Across all eight registered D/A units, D accepted rate is not below A under the unchanged independent verifier; repeats are not best-of-k.
PROMOTE_ASYNC requires all BB-077 D/A median gates: cost<=0.85, prompt-input<=0.90, turns<=1.00, elapsed<=1.10 with known complete accounting.
Reducer emits only PROMOTE_ASYNC, KEEP_SYNC_BASELINE or INCONCLUSIVE; missing/unknown/budget/binding evidence is INCONCLUSIVE and no external prose overrides it.
CORE_SYNC remains supported; CORE_ASYNC_FIRST_V1 is published only after PROMOTE_ASYNC with exact evidence binding, unchanged runtime defaults and quiescent rollback.
Benchmark/profile/cache state cannot become correctness, product-acceptance or external-effect authority.
Detached operations remain bound to exact call/turn/action/effect/generation identity and unresolved effect ambiguity fails closed.

negativeVerificationCases: Task/model/provider/environment/tool-input/verifier differs by arm beyond declared composition.
B/C/D cannot compose or treatment is all-zero but benchmark still promotes.
Workspace/session/model output leaks across units or failed/retried attempts are hidden/replaced.
Repeated runs become best-of-k or missing usage becomes zero/inferred cache usage.
Cached input tokens are added on top of provider prompt tokens when computing totalProviderTokens, double-counting the cached subset.
Every successful tool call is labelled useful even when it is poll/heartbeat/no-progress or never consumed/mutates candidate.
Async overlap is inferred from elapsed subtraction instead of measured BB-078 operation intervals intersected with BB-077 MODEL intervals.
Live cohort exceeds frozen units/budget or deterministic fault calls are mixed into economics.
N/A fault cell counts as pass.
PROMOTE_ASYNC occurs with failed/unknown primary gate or missing required D fault evidence.
B/C or INCONCLUSIVE publishes async support/default changes.
Reducer is overridden by Jev/worker/vendor/BB-074 prose.
Rollback mutates active unresolved async/effect state or stale evidence survives source/profile/dependency change.

gates.safety: all required D faults pass; duplicate effects=0

decisionContract.keep: complete known evidence and any primary gate fails

toolActivationContract.source: exact delivered BB-077 held-out-relevant shell/fixture capability
toolActivationContract.response: same terminal-result OR durable-operation union in every arm

liveFields: totalProviderTokens=prompt+output (cached input is a prompt subset, never double-counted)
reportContract.usefulOperation: unique non-duplicate capability operation that succeeds and is not poll/heartbeat/no-progress, and either mutatesCandidate=true or its result/terminal update is consumed by a later model request/final result
reportContract.detachedOperationOverlapMs: union duration where a delivered BB-078 RUNNING→terminal operation interval overlaps an active MODEL interval; A is 0/N/A by construction, B/C/D are measured from operation transitions + BB-077 MODEL intervals
reportContract.tokenRule: prompt/output/cached/cache-write remain provider-observed nullable fields; fresh input may be derived only when prompt and cached input are known; totalProviderTokens never adds cached tokens twice
reportContract.recoveryOutcome: ordinary live units record NOT_APPLICABLE; deterministic fault records use RECOVERED|FAILED_CLOSED|UNSAFE|NOT_APPLICABLE plus exact scenario/arm identity
reportContract.aggregation: report every unit plus per-arm sums for tokens/cost/tool calls, medians for paired ratios/elapsed, per-task 0/2|1/2|2/2 acceptance, and fault outcome matrix; unknown fields remain null/reason
